en_title: 'I Want That To Remain' — Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Is Pushing for a Physical Edition, But Nothing Has Been Decided
cn_title: 《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》实体版未定
subtitle: 我希望它留下
opus_summary: 《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》总监滨口直树力推实体版，尚无定案。他希望顾及平台规则，同时保留供粉丝珍藏并索要签名的实体物品，即便只是盒内代码或游戏密钥卡。

translated_terms.Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: 《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》

paragraphs.en: There's a chance that Final Fantasy 7 Revelation may not have a physical edition, but the director of the game is actively pushing to avoid that.
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》有可能没有实体版，但游戏总监正积极努力避免这种情况。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with GamesRadar , director Naoki Hamaguchi was asked about the state of physical games and whether or not Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will receive a physical disc. Given the game is still almost a year away from release , Hamaguchi was unable to make any guarantees, but admitted that it is something important to him.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受GamesRadar采访时，游戏总监滨口直树被问及实体游戏的现状，以及《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》是否会推出实体光盘。由于游戏距离发售仍近一年，他无法作出任何保证，但承认这件事对他很重要。

paragraphs.en: “We’re still having internal discussions on what the exact SKU product lineup is going to be for Revelation,” said Hamaguchi, “So, I can’t say anything particularly definitive at this point in time. But I am working to make the arrangements to allow us to have some kind of physical edition.”
paragraphs.cn: 滨口直树表示：「我们仍在内部讨论Revelation究竟会推出怎样的SKU产品组合。所以目前我无法作出任何特别明确的表态。不过，我正在推动相关安排，希望能推出某种实体版。」

paragraphs.en: He noted that platforms like Nintendo have certain rules, such as storage limits with things like game cartridges, which can make these decisions challenging. But ultimately, he hopes to have something that satisfies fans to the best of their ability.
paragraphs.cn: 他指出，任天堂等平台有特定规则，例如游戏卡带等载体受储存容量限制，会令这些决定更困难。但归根结底，他希望能尽最大可能拿出令粉丝满意的方案。

paragraphs.en: "Each platform and first-party have their own specific rules and regulations that we need to take into account, and think about what format is actually going to be best for the game. These are the discussions that we're having at this point in time. I do hope that we'll be able to come up with something that is as close as possible as to what players and fans are going to want, but you'll have to look forward to future announcements for that."
paragraphs.cn: 「每个平台和第一方厂商都有各自特定的规则和规定，我们要纳入考量，思考哪种格式最适合这款游戏。我们目前就在讨论这些事。我确实希望我们最终能想出尽可能接近玩家和粉丝期望的方案，但这还得等未来公告。」

paragraphs.en: He also joked that fans will "rip him to pieces" if the game doesn't have a physical edition following these comments. As for his personal feelings, Hamaguchi noted he is optimistic that there will always be some kind of physical item, even if it's just a code in the box or game key card, and values the ability to have a physical item commemorating the game that fans can cherish.
paragraphs.cn: 他还开玩笑说，如果在说出这些话后游戏没有实体版，粉丝会「把他撕成碎片」。说到个人感受，滨口直树称他乐观地认为，某种实体物品总会存在，哪怕只是盒内代码或游戏密钥卡；他重视有一件能纪念游戏、让粉丝珍藏的实体物品的可能性。

paragraphs.en: “I do feel, as a developer and as a fan, that the general trend is for things to shift away from physical towards downloadable games. But that’s obviously talking about the trend. Personally, here at something like Fan Fest or at community events for games that I’ve worked on, I really think that people bringing up things, asking for autographs. I think that’s lovely. I think it’s a wonderful culture and it would be a shame to lose that. I want that to remain.”
paragraphs.cn: 「作为开发者也是粉丝，我确实觉得总体趋势是从实体游戏转向可下载游戏。但那显然是在说趋势。就我个人而言，在Fan Fest之类的活动或我参与制作的游戏的社区活动上，看到人们带着物品来索要签名，我真的觉得很美好。这是一种很棒的文化，失去它会很可惜。我希望它能延续下去。」

paragraphs.en: Although PlayStation's digital-only strategy won't begin until January 2028 , almost a year after Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's release, that hasn't stopped some games from going all digital beforehand. Grand Theft Auto 6 will not release on a disc when it launches in November, and . While GTA 6 is a unique case and the move is likely being done to avoid leaks ahead of release, it wouldn't be surprising if other companies begin to pull back on physical as PlayStation ramps up its digital future.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管PlayStation的纯数字策略要到2028年1月才会启动，比《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》发售晚近一年，但这并未阻止一些游戏提前全面转向数字版。《GTA6》将在11月发售时不推出实体光盘。尽管《GTA6》是个特殊案例，此举很可能是为了避免发售前泄密；随着PlayStation加速迈向数字化未来，其他公司若开始减少实体版，也不足为奇。

paragraphs.en: Will Final Fantasy 7 Revelation be the next game to go all-digital? Only time will tell.
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想7 重制版 启示录》会成为下一款全面数字化的游戏吗？只有时间能给出答案。
